SAYANTAN  PAUL 
Business Analyst | Financial Services | Agile Delivery  
sayantan1997paul@gmail.com | +91- 7044410455 | India 
 
PROFESSIONAL  SUMMARY 
 
Business Analyst with 5 years of experience across financial services — insurance, banking, and payments — gathering and validating 
business requirements, mapping processes, and partnering with product, operations, and technical stakeholders to translate data insight into 
documented, testable requirements. Comfortable moving between requirements documentation, SQL/Excel-based analysis, and Agile delivery, 
with a consistent focus on tracing requirements back to quantified business impact. Domain range spans policy and claims lifecycle, retail 
banking and payments operations, and financial reporting, with the underlying BA toolkit — stakeholder facilitation, process mapping, 
BRDs/FRDs, UAT — applied consistently across each. 
CORE COMPETENCIES  
• Business Analysis: Requirements Gathering & Validation, BRDs/FRDs, User Stories & Epics, Process Mapping (As-Is/To-Be, BPMN), 
RFP/RFI Response, Stakeholder Facilitation, Gap Analysis 
• Financial Services Domain: P&C Insurance (Policy & Claim Lifecycle), Retail Banking, Payments Operations (UPI, NEFT/RTGS, Card 
Lifecycle awareness), KYC/AML, Financial Reporting, Data Validation 
• QA & Testing: Manual Functional/Regression/UAT Testing, Test Case Design & Documentation, Requirement-to-Test Traceability, 
Defect Tracking 
• Tools & Delivery: SQL, Advanced Excel, Python, Power BI, Azure, JIRA, MS Visio, Lucid Chart, Guidewire PolicyCenter (awareness) 
• Emerging: Prompt Engineering, Claude, Gen AI, LLM, Lovable AI, Napkin AI 
PROFESSIONAL  EXPERIENCE  
Business Analyst | Intact Insurance (123.ie) — Ireland Apr 2024 – Present 
• Contributed, alongside the Data Analytics team, to root-cause analysis that traced 46% of policy declines to outdated acceptance criteria; 
documented the revised business rules and functional requirements with underwriting stakeholders, supporting a 3-point rise in quotability 
and an estimated +€54K/month in premium. 
• Prepared test scripts for functional and non-functional testing and executed System, System Integration, Compatibility, Performance, and 
User Acceptance Testing (UAT). 
• Used GA4 and Hotjar to diagnose funnel drop-off against an 85% completion target as part of a forward-looking transformation 
programme; identified a segment-level conversion gap that fed into a product recommendation - a diagnostic approach transferable to any 
digital customer journey. 
• Translated inbound call pattern analysis and customer journey pain points into functional requirements for a self-service feature, partnering 
with cross-functional product, data, and engineering teams to reduce manual service volume. 
• Engaged stakeholders to define current- and future-state needs through structured gap analysis, gathered and validated functional 
requirements and facilitated workshops across product, data, and engineering squads. 
• Mapped As-Is/To-Be process flows in Lucid Chart for core lifecycle journeys - a process-mapping discipline directly applicable to account 
opening, payments, and servicing workflows in banking. 
• Initiated, groomed, and took part in Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, and Sprint Retrospective meetings. 
Senior Analyst — Presales & Business Analysis | Capgemini Sep 2021 – Aug 2022 
• Partnered with bid managers on RFP and RFI responses for global alliance partners; gathered stakeholder requirements and translated them 
into solution and process flow diagrams for proposal submissions. 
• One of two analysts consolidating and validating deal-stage and deal-value data across a ~€300M practice-level revenue pipeline, tracking 
deal stages and forecasts and driving practice-level financial reporting across live and prospective bids. 
• Built weekly pipeline and bid-status reports in Excel and Power BI, presented to practice leadership to support revenue forecasting and 
planning. 
Business Analyst — QA & Testing | Cognizant Nov 2019 – Sep 2021 
• Performed manual functional, regression, and UAT testing for a financial services client, designing and documenting test cases and test 
scripts directly from business requirements and functional specifications. 
• Maintained test case libraries and requirement-to-test traceability matrices across releases, and logged and tracked defects through to 
closure. 
• Produced weekly test status and quality reports for stakeholders, and built working knowledge of Selenium to support automation of 
regression test suites. 
EDUCATION 
• MSc in Business Analytics | National University of Ireland, Galway | 2022 – 2023 
• B.Tech in Electrical Engineering | India | 2015 – 2019 
ADDITIONAL  
• Claude Cowork Certified; Claude AI Capabilities and Limitations Certified; CCBA certification ongoing.
